items.title: 68089_John Malachi oral history interview
items.q: Hot Lips Page came into the Yacht Club

ctx.x: think Coleman Hawkins went into the Three Deuces, and Hot Lips Page came into the Yacht Club. The bands were always switching around like that.

I remember one time Coleman Hawkins had a band in a place called Kelly's Stables. Once they recorded this thing with Dizzy Gillespie, and I remember Leo Parker was playing alto saxophone on that. "Disorder At The Border" -- there were four sides they did, I think.
